nodes.label: Clean-room rule
nodes.rationale: Other download managers are used only to learn what users expect, never as a source of code or assets.

nodes.label: Dependencies policy (minimum third-party deps)
nodes.rationale: Add a dependency only when writing it ourselves would be unreasonable or unsafe; std lib first, then existing lockfile crates, new last; always use maintained libs for TLS/crypto.

nodes.label: reqwest 0.13.5 (rustls only, HTTP/1.1)
nodes.rationale: default-features off, only rustls: no HTTP/2, no decompression, no system proxy.

nodes.label: rustls + aws-lc-rs + rustls-platform-verifier TLS chain
nodes.rationale: Listed for TLS audit trail; OS trust store verification; no OpenSSL or native-tls.

nodes.label: Direct-to-place writes (pre-allocated, ~1 MB buffers)
nodes.rationale: No part files and no merge step; buffering avoids hitting disk per packet.

nodes.label: Giving up: retiring connection hands range back
nodes.norm_label: giving up: retiring connection hands range back
nodes.rationale: A server that accepts fewer connections than opened still completes over the accepted ones; only the last connection giving up fails the download.

nodes.label: Being a good client (<=32 connections, honour Retry-After)
nodes.norm_label: being a good client (<=32 connections, honour retry-after)

nodes.label: Per-range retry (exponential backoff, full jitter, Retry-After)
nodes.norm_label: per-range retry (exponential backoff, full jitter, retry-after)

nodes.label: Speed from per-connection server limits
nodes.rationale: Servers often limit per connection; N connections get up to N shares until line/disk is the limit. 20x needs per-connection throttling, >=20 allowed connections and line headroom.

nodes.label: Separate HTTP/1.1 connections on purpose
nodes.rationale: Per-connection limits apply to a whole HTTP/2 connection, so ranges use separate TCP connections, kept alive and reused.

nodes.label: CSP configuration (tauri.conf.json)
nodes.rationale: connect-src ipc: for Tauri IPC; dangerousDisableAssetCspModification style-src so Tauri adds no style nonce, which would make browsers ignore unsafe-inline and block the style tag Radix dialogs inject.

nodes.label: Always get the best available quality
nodes.norm_label: always get the best available quality
nodes.rationale: On by default; audio not re-encoded since converting cannot add quality; no silent fallback to lower quality.

nodes.label: yt-dlp as unmodified Tauri sidecar
nodes.rationale: Video sites change often; maintaining own extractors is unrealistic; using yt-dlp unmodified is consistent with clean-room.

nodes.label: UI direction spec
nodes.rationale: IDM-style single window: everything visible, nothing hidden behind menus, with a modern look.

nodes.label: Range map file <file>.ksdm
nodes.rationale: Written only with a strong validator; saved every 2 s by syncing data first then atomic rename, so it never lists bytes not on disk; deleted before fresh start.

nodes.label: App Icon (app-icon.svg)
nodes.description: 1024x1024 application icon for ks-download-manager: a white download glyph (downward arrow over a horizontal tray line) on a blue rounded-square tile.
nodes.rationale: A universal download symbol states the app's purpose at a glance; own simple geometric design per the clean-room rule of never copying reference apps' icons.

nodes.label: Rounded-square blue gradient tile
nodes.description: 896x896 rect at (64,64) with rx=200, filled with a vertical linear gradient from #2b8fd6 (top) to #14609e (bottom).
nodes.rationale: 64px inset margin and large corner radius match desktop (macOS-style) app-icon conventions; top-to-bottom light-to-dark blue gives depth and a calm, trustworthy utility look.

nodes.label: Tray / baseline bar
nodes.description: White horizontal line from (312,772) to (712,772), stroke width 84, round caps, beneath the arrow.
nodes.rationale: Represents the destination (disk/tray) the download lands on, completing the standard download metaphor.

nodes.label: Download arrow glyph
nodes.description: White stroked path: vertical shaft from (512,232) to (512,632) with a chevron head (352,482)-(512,642)-(672,482); stroke width 84, round caps and joins.
nodes.rationale: Thick rounded strokes stay legible at small icon sizes (taskbar, dock).
